name: Yuanwu

tierList.prydwen: Support: T4 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: Free 4-star Electro Gauntlets Support with the shortest rotation in the game and zero investment requirement, but almost no buffing kit beyond team-wide Interruption Resistance and Vibration Strength (stagger) damage. Sole niche: highest-uptime Coordinated Attack generator for Jinhsi's Forte stacks.

skills.resonanceSkill: Thunder Wedge - summons a field dealing Electro DMG, launches Coordinated Attacks on ally hits (builds Forte off-field).
skills.forte: Unassuming Blade - at full Readiness (max 100), Rumbling Spark detonates the Thunder Wedge and enters Lightning Infused (enhanced Basic/Heavy/Dodge Counter, team-wide Interruption Resistance on Ultimate).
skills.liberation: Blazing Might - grants Lightning Infused (Anti-interruption) to nearby team for 10s + Electro hit, detonates Thunder Wedge.
skills.outro: Lightning Manipulation - Electro field dealing heavy Vibration Strength (stagger) damage.

bestWeapons: Originite: Type IV (86.7%, support-build - enables Rejuvenating Glow)
echoSet: Rejuvenating Glow (best, with Originite: Type IV weapon for self-healing)
Moonlit Clouds (alt, 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro)

teams.name: Jinhsi Team
teams.notes: Only real meta use case - highest Coordinated Attack frequency of any character for filling Jinhsi's Forte, at essentially zero investment (level 1, 3-star weapon, level 0 Echoes still works).

rotation: No fixed rotation - place Thunder Wedge, detonate via Ultimate or Forte Skill, replace Wedge, repeat. Priority: Echo -> Intro (if available) -> Skill: place Wedge -> Ultimate (detonate) -> Forte Skill: Rumbling Spark -> Skill: place Wedge -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: the easiest character in the game to play (basic, skill, echo, swap off) with zero build requirements and team-wide anti-interruption utility, but provides almost no damage buffs and is usable in exactly one team (Jinhsi) as a free, low-effort Forte-stack generator.
